preconditions.description: The number of gnomes N is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= g[i][j] <= 1 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each entry g[i][j] in the adjacency matrix is either 0 or 1.
The number of queries M is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 10**9 for k, x in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query's k (time) is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N for k, x in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query's x (gnome id) is between 1 and N inclusive.
The number of queries parsed matches the given M.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines per query (count and list of gnomes).

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[2 * i] == str(len(gnomes_at_time)) for i in range(M) for gnomes_at_time in gnomes_at_time_list)
postconditions.description: The first line of each query's output is the count of gnomes who know the joke after k minutes.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[2 * i + 1] == ' '.join(map(str, sorted(gnomes_at_time))) if gnomes_at_time else output_lines[2 * i + 1] == '-1') for i in range(M) for gnomes_at_time in gnomes_at_time_list)
postconditions.description: The second line of each query's output is either the sorted list of gnome IDs (1-based) who know the joke after k minutes or '-1' if no gnomes know it.

postconditions.expression: all(gnomes_at_time == set(gnomes_reachable_in_k_minutes) for gnomes_reachable_in_k_minutes in gnomes_reachable_in_k_minutes_list)
postconditions.description: For each query (k, x), the set of gnomes who know the joke after k minutes is exactly the set of gnomes reachable from x in k or fewer steps in the adjacency graph.
